skills.name: Health professionals; reading an interview with a dentist

worked_example.problem: {n} has a toothache. Write what she says to the receptionist, and what the dentist may ask her.
steps: To the receptionist: “Good morning. I have a toothache. Can I see the dentist, please?”
The dentist asks where and how long: “Which tooth hurts? How long have you had the pain?”
{n} answers clearly: “The back tooth on the left. Since Monday.”
worked_example.answer: “I have a toothache. Can I see the dentist, please?” — “Which tooth hurts? How long have you had the pain?”

cards.idea: Read the interview between a journalist and a dentist.
example: Journalist: Good morning, doctor. What does a dentist do?
Dentist: I take care of people's teeth and gums. I check them, clean them, fill holes and sometimes take out bad teeth.
Journalist: How often should we visit a dentist?
Dentist: Twice a year, even when nothing hurts. A small problem is easier to treat.
Dentist: Sugar. Sweets and soft drinks feed the germs that make holes in our teeth. Brush in the morning and before you sleep.

pick.r: in the morning and before we sleep

e: The dentist answered.

cards.idea: Each health professional has a special job.
example: A dentist cares for teeth; an optician tests eyes.
A pharmacist sells medicines; a midwife helps women give birth.

cards.idea: At a clinic, say clearly what is wrong, and answer the questions.
example: “How long have you had it?” — “Since yesterday.”
